text_block_list.text: Gold Ship came through with great results!

At this rate, she'll likely perform brilliantly
in the Classic stage next year as well...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! It had an aroma so savory
even dried stingray fin would be jealous, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Man, after conquering the land, she went and conquered the sea too, huh~"
In reality, it was a track race on land, so we hadn't conquered the sea, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: In that case, hasn't she basically done everything there is to do in the Twinkle Series?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Guess I've got nowhere to unleash this burning fighting spirit of mine anymore...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Guess I got no choice. Maybe I should just get a job putting those little green plastic grass dividers in bento boxes."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, filling those fish-shaped soy sauce bottles with soy sauce
might actually be a pretty nice job, huh~

The real battle in the Twinkle Series
begins with the Classic season—

Just as I was about to convince her
that she could run even more thrilling racesâ

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Mmh?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO
OOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!!
Look, Trainer, it's a massive discovery!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap...
The next volume of the 'Secret Scroll' was lying right here on the ground!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! It's that book about the Umamusume utopia,
Eden...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: *Gulp*... I-I'm gonna read it...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"O mighty Umamusume who seeks Eden.
Thou shalt do battle with fierce rivals on the Classic stage..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Then shall the path unto Eden
reveal itself in due course...”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Holy shiiiiiiiiit!!
That sounds super fuuuuun!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —I'd completely forgotten about Eden, though!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In short, I just gotta crush the strongest runners
in the Classic triple crown, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, my muscles are rarin' to go...!!
I'm bursting with power!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer, follow me!!
We're gonna start training the Blazing Annihilation Fist right now!!"
I'm not entirely sure why, but she seems completely fired up for the Classics!
